sub_answers.text: The Sartell mill removed paper clips and staples in a sorting room before sending waste to cookers for deinking and bleaching. [d6550336s1p0] Coating preparation at the Sartell mill used a starch-and-clay conversion process, with coating ingredients mixed in a slurry makedown tank, screened, and pumped through stages for enzyme addition and cooking. [d6550336s9p0] The Sartell mill’s No. 3 paper machine used a Voith dilution control headbox to improve profile and formation and a gap former to improve sheet formation and paper quality. [d6550336s10p0] The No. 3 paper machine’s press section used a Beloit twinver with an inclined straight-through, grooved third press, and the main dryer section used 43 six-foot dryers split into four sections. [d6550336s10p0]

sub_answers.text: In July 2014, the firm announced plans to lay off 18,000 employees, including 12,500 professional and factory personnel, as its biggest layoff ever. [d19001s14p0] In September 2014, it laid off 2,100 people, including 747 employees in the Seattle–Redmond area. [d19001s14p0] In October 2014, it revealed it was almost done eliminating the full 18,000 employees from that sweep. [d19001s14p0] In July 2015, it announced another 7,800 job cuts in the following months. [d19001s14p0] The firm also closed its office in Pakistan and laid off its employees there as part of its move to a software-as-a-service and AI operating model. [d19001s14p0]
